principles: Fixed RAR engineering boundaries, not biological cut-points
High scores saturate; larger is not unboundedly better
R4 remains blocked from Official route until measurement stability gate is cleared

R3.note: R3-S contour is stored separately and does not cap R3-L points

R4.1: min width>=15 cm-eq and max adjacent step<=6
R4.2: min width>=18 and max adjacent step<=4.5

T2.1: continuous but no independent positive anchor
T2.2: residual<=0.020 AND visible dorsal span<=98 cm-eq

freeze_scope: Numeric engineering boundaries for CLPP Beta QA; reopen only for demonstrated calculation/measurement/scientific defect, not score distribution or race results.
